data.bottom_line: Expect a mix of crusts, wet snow, wind-textured snow, and a few pockets of soft snow in the backcountry. Pay attention to conditions as you travel, and change plans if you see signs of unstable snow or unexpected conditions. Even though avalanches may be unlikely, keep using best practices like traveling one at a time through avalanche terrain and regrouping in safe zones outside avalanche paths or runout zones.
